What is an eSIM?


eSIM is a digital SIM card that is built into a device, like a watch or a smartphone, also referred to as an embedded SIM. It eliminates the need for a physical SIM card and enables users to transfer mobile networks without manually exchanging SIM cards. This technology gives users who frequently travel or transfer mobile carriers more flexibility and convenience. 


How does eSIM work?


eSIM works by storing multiple mobile network profiles on a single device. When a user wants to switch networks, they can simply select the desired network profile from their device settings. The eSIM then connects to the chosen network, allowing the user to access data as if they were using a physical SIM card. This process is done electronically, eliminating the need to physically swap SIM cards.
